update.description: AgentPort checks for a new version at launch and downloads it in the background. Installing closes running sessions, so it always asks first.
update.idle: Updates are checked when AgentPort starts.
update.ready: AgentPort {{version}} is downloaded. Use “Quit and update” in the prompt at the bottom left.
update.installing: Stopping running sessions and installing the update…
update.disabled: This build never checks for updates (development build or updates disabled).
